155858.name: Seward County Community College
155858.notes: SiteGround 'Robot Challenge' (202 + sgcaptcha redirect) blocks requests AND the WP Job Manager feed (?feed=job_feed also 202); headless Chromium passes and the listing shows 11 WP Job Manager jobs ('Computer Information System Instructor', 'Automotive Technology Adjunct Instructor', /job/<slug>). Verified 2026-10-16. CAVEAT: SiteGround challenge returns 202 on the first load of a fresh Chromium context and 200 on the next load of the same context (challenge cookie); the generic fetcher only accepts 200, so a scan may need to load the page twice.

217925.name: Columbia International University
217925.notes: Bot wall (nginx 403) on the whole site for requests; headless Chromium got through on the first audit pass (29 /position/<slug> links incl. 'CIU Global Adjunct Faculty', 'Digital Media and Cinema Adjunct Faculty', 'Director of Corporate IT') but returned 403 on later passes the same day, so the wall is IP/rate based - expect intermittent results. SIDE DOOR: https://ciu.edu/position-sitemap.xml (Yoast sitemap of the 'position' post type, 33 URLs) stays reachable while every HTML page, feed and wp-json endpoint 403s; a sitemap-aware fetcher could list postings from it. Verified 2026-10-16.
